notes.title: Achievement Fix Update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/975d8420b9a55bca03b726bc28a133c12a8d0d65.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Sorry for the long silence! We’re back with some partially good news! 😊 We’ve updated the game build, and now achievements should work properly for everyone! To unlock an achievement, just go to sleep in the cabin (sometimes they don’t trigger right away, so be patient).[/p][p]That’s all the good news for now. We’re currently waiting for our artist to be able to continue working on the next part of the game. Thanks for your awesome feedback—it really helps us out! And a huge thank you for staying part of our community—you guys are amazing! 💪[/p]

notes.title: Final release and machine localization
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/974edde53f642caeef9bbdd04ea302c0dc53ba69.png[/img]

Hello everyone from the Hotbunny team! We've got some news to share regarding the project.

As we've mentioned before, we can't continue development on the sequel or other "Pirates" universe games because part of the team is on an indefinite pause. 

However, Hotbunny is eager to resume work as soon as all team members are back in action!

[b]Today, some of the team managed to implement machine translations for several languages and fixed some issues that were bugging players. From today, we're officially releasing the game from Early Access. Thanks for sticking with us and enjoying the game all this time. Here's hoping we'll return to normal operations soon![/b]

Here's what's been updated:

[b]Fixed translations for Russian and English.[/b]

Added machine translations for:
[list]
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Czech
[*] Chinese
[*] Vietnamese
[/list]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40541921/93c220c17fbea56296e549d14f19e10595899eee.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.22.1
notes.content:
Pirates! We are pleased to present you with a new update to our game!

Patchcoat version 0.22:
[list]
[*] Added "Melissa's Experiments" quest.
[*] Added erotic scene with Melissa.
[*] Added 18+ scene with Melissa and the captain.
[*] Added new character "The Red Cap".
[*] Added 18+ scene with Sophia and the Captain ( 5th meeting at the massage parlor)
[*] [b][u]FISHING GLOBAL BAG fixed (the mini-game did not work on high-core monitors).[/u][/b]
[*] Fixed the stuttering in events and pirate hunts.
[*] Fixed crashes when using zels.
[/list]

[u][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/u]: This version is only available in two languages English and Russian. New content can be found immediately New Game -> Parrot Adventures -> Go to Melissa's cabin and go to bed.

[u][b]IMPORTANT-2:[/b][/u] New content may not work or cause bugs when using old saves!

notes.title: Small devlog!
notes.content:
Yo-ho-ho pirates! 

A small devlog on the main game, because there was no news for a long time (They are just all on patreon, and duplicate them here all the time we will get you) 

- Already completed the first quest with Melissa ( Witch's daughter we take to the ship )
- We have begun rendering the new scenes for the baths with Melissa and Julia.

Also would like to show one of the new locations on the quest with Melissa!

This topic can be used for your wishes! Thanks for following the game!
